requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-5400-5929--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Synth Infiltrator. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3899-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-5131-5645-8095--202.easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5645-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

791-4591-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
791-4591-8089.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2447-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

662-2388-6587-7309.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
662-2388-6587-7309.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-1618-2440-6596.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Hermes
80-1618-2440-6596.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Hermes triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-1618-2440-6596.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Hermes. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2060-2713-5140-7315.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-5140-7315.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1069-1232-5499-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5499-7297.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-1233-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-1233-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4484-4668-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4668-4871-5256-5643.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
4484-4668-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4668-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

3967-4605-6132-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-3967-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1456-3967-4871-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

719-5256-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-5256-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2921-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

3944-4063-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3678-6879-6902.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-6879-6902.description:
Play Crosis's Catacombs.
When Crosis's Catacombs enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Crosis's Catacombs.
Resolve the Crosis's Catacombs trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Crosis's Catacombs from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

539-579-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-579-4657.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {4} due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

1477-4242-5660.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Su-Chi, targeting Evolution Witness.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1429-4452-5147-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4452-5147-5402.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2061-3277-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-3277-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3263-4893-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
3263-4893-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1762-2511-4871-5173-5626.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

369-539-1315-2730.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-539-1315-2730.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability from step 1, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

678-3259-4066.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other Horse you control with lesser base power than Shadowfax's power.
You have a Horse creature card in hand with lesser base power than Shadowfax's power.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
678-3259-4066.description:
Declare Shadowfax and the Horse with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Shadowfax triggers, putting a Horse creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Shadowfax and the two other Horses.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Horse it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another Horse except Shadowfax, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Horse that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the Horse to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1283-1376-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Priest of Titania.
You control at least two Elves.
1283-1376-4222.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

220-2773-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Brash Taunter.
You have a way to deal damage to Brash Taunter.
220-2773-3828.description:
Deal damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter and Druid's Call trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing that much damage to target opponent.
Resolve the Druid's Call trigger, creating that many 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Each Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge that many times.
Resolve all but one Warstorm Surge trigger, causing the Squirrels to each deal one damage to any target.
Resolve the final Warstorm Surge trigger, causing a Squirrel to deal one damage to Brash Taunter.
Repeat from step 2.

129-2816-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Incubation Druid.
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
129-2816-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color a land you control could produce.
Kinnan triggers, adding one mana of the color produced by Incubation Druid.
Activate Incubation Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
If you gain infinite {U} and {G} this way, you may activate Kinnan's ability an arbitraily large number of times.

541-3395-3617-3634.notablePrerequisites:
{3}{U}{U}{U} available each turn.
An additional {3} or {U} available to activate Crystal Shard.
541-3395-3617-3634.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Crystal Shard by tapping it and paying {3} or {U}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
